class.name: Awakened Spiritcaller Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Spiritcaller Class

skills.name: Ancestral Stallion
lore: Jump and sneak while in air to summon a spiritual horse and mount
it. Dismounting despawns the horse into spiritual dust.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Spiritual Combo
lore: Fight alongside a manifested spiritual spear, striking with fluid,
ritualistic motion.
1st-2nd Strike: A diagonal spear slash sweeps across the body.
3rd Strike: Stride forward, spinning the spear in a wide arc along the
side, cleaving enemies ahead.
4th Strike: A quick backward dash transitions into a sudden forward
thrust, piercing through enemies.
5th Strike: Leaping into the air, spin the spear overhead before
driving it diagonally downward, smashing both the ground and airborne
enemies beneath.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Wraith Serpent
lore: A spectral serpent is summoned and slithers across the ground.
Wraith Serpent (Melee Minion)
Bite: The serpent bites enemies with its fangs, dealing damage and
poisoning them.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {poisonduration}s Poison Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Spirit Golem
lore: Summon an ancestral golem to protect you.
Spirit Golem (Melee Minion)
Ground Slam: The golem slams the ground with crushing force,
stunning enemies.
Guardian Ward: The golem creates a protective spirit zone.
The zone grants you and your allies Resistance III while pushing away
enemies, forbidding them from entering the zone.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {stunduration}s Stun Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Spiritcallers Command
lore: Switch summon modes between Focus, Free, and Idle mode.
Focus Mode: Your minions attack only the enemy you last
dealt damage to.
Free Mode: Your minions attack random enemies, excluding
party/guild members.
Idle Mode: Your minions don't attack enemies and only follow you.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Spirit Talon
lore: Summon a powerful talon spirit descending from above.
Spirit Talon (Ranged Minion)
Cyclone Shot: The Talon launches a slicing spirit tornado
toward enemies, knocking them up. The tornado pierces through enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Ancestral Tiger
lore: Summon an ancient tiger spirit, an embodiment of primal dominance.
While the tiger is present, you gain increased movement speed and
strength, empowered by ancestral ferocity.
Ancestral Tiger (Melee Minion)
Savage Pounce: The tiger lunges onto its target in a devastating
pounce, carving an X-shaped slash that damages all enemies at the
impact point and slightly knocking them back.
Dominance Roar: With a thunderous roar, the tiger weakens and slows
surrounding enemies, asserting its dominion over the battlefield.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {debuffduration}s Debuff Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
